variant_name: Third autocorrelation constant, signed f, maximum of the absolute value

definition.text: C = the largest constant with max_t |(f*f)(t)| >= C (int f)^2 for every real f supported on [-1/4,1/4]. Any explicit f gives the upper bound C <= max_t |(f*f)(t)| / (int f)^2. Entries record the best upper bound.

source.citation: This registry, certificate certificates/third_autocorrelation_abs_inside (300-cell step function; exact rational evaluation)

superseded.source: prior bound cited by the v2 paper for problem 6.4(a)

conflation_note: Not the same variant as the absolute-value-outside-the-maximum problem scored by benchmark validators (values near 1.449-1.4557). The 2025 notebook calls this one C3' (1.4688); the v2 paper calls it problem 6.4(a). Follow-on papers and leaderboards target the other variant.
